title: Accha hua Sugra
body:
Acha hua sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ahle haram aaye madine may palay kar
sughra se kaha saniye zehra ne lipat kar
acha hua sughra tu mere saath nahi thi
zainab ka tha noha hum lut gaye sughra
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
<<DIVIDER>>
1. is baat pe karti hoo ada shukr ka sajda
hum may se kisi ka to salamat raha parda
kis tarha bataun tujhe dil phat ta hai mera
sadaat ki ghairat ka taqaza nahi sughra
bas itna hi kehti hoo rida jab ke chini thi
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. tu poochti hai surkh hai kyun aap ki chadar
aa tujhko bataun mere mazloom ki dukhktar
jab qaime may sheh laaye laashe ali akbar
mai aise giri laash ke pehlu may tadap kar
akbar ke lahoo se ye rida surkh hui thi
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. kis tarha rahi hogi tu is ghar may akeli
ehsaas mujhe hai tere is dard ka beti lekin tu zaeefa hui furqat may padar ki
tujhko to khabar sirf shahadat ki hai
pahunchi
mai sheh ka gala kat-te hue dekh rahi thi
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. kya bughz hai baba se musalmano ko jaane phir aaye thay ghar fathema zehra ka jalane
sab aake khade hogaye bekas ke sarhane
us waqt sitamgaron se abid ko bachane
beti phupi amma teri sholo pe chali thi
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. tanhai may le jaake kabhi poochna maa se
kis tarha se guzri teri maa behne wahan se
baatein jahan sab karte hai pathar ki zuban
se
<<DIVIDER>>
shab ko bhi guzarna bada mushkil hai jahan
se
be-parda din may wahan har ek bibi khadi
thi
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. nana ka madina hai nahi khauf kisi ka
dil khol ke ro kaun tujhe maarega durra lekin kabhi baba pe jo roti thi sakina
sayli kabhi durra kabhi khati thi tamacha
rone pe bhi masoom ke pabandi lagi thi
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. ay mir takallum wo qayamat thi qayamat
zainab ne sunayi jo sakina ki shahadat
sadaat pe sughra tha ajab aalam e ghurbat
zindan ke andhere may banayi gayi turbat
dam tod ti bachi ne bhi ye baat kahi thi
<<MINI>>
acha hua sughra....
